data.claim: The safest protocol is a conservative two-phase commitment where a workspace is never reclaimed after a crash unless a pre-declared 'prepared-to-terminate' record exists, allowing an external auditor to verify that no evidence was completed before the crash.
data.qualification: Mechanism: durably write a 'prepared' record containing the Merkle root of workspace contents before terminal phase. If crash occurs without 'committed' record, recompute workspace from prepared root, verify no evidence nodes, then issue a signed attestation of emptiness. Durably recorded: prepared root and post-crash audit attestation.
